title: Stocks Climb as Oil Pares Gain on Iran Deal Hopes
text:
Becca Wasser, an adjunct senior fellow at the Center for a New American Security, joins Bloomberg Surveillance to discuss missile stockpiles, the war in Iran, and a possible timeline for replenishing supplies.
Listen to the full episode on Bloomberg.
